context: Discussing a court ruling on discrimination
purpose: Discuss a ruling; teach 差別/裁判所/義務/総理/国務大臣/局長/設立/副

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 差別を巡る件で、裁判所が判決を出しましたね。
lines.en: The court issued a ruling on the discrimination case.
lines.style: informed student raising the news, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、最高裁判所まで争われた事件です。
lines.en: Yes, it was fought up to the Supreme Court.
lines.style: teacher noting the case’s weight, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 企業には、差別をしない義務があるんですね。
lines.en: Companies have a duty not to discriminate.
lines.style: teen grasping the legal obligation, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうです。総理も会見で言及しました。
lines.en: Right. The prime minister mentioned it at a briefing.
lines.style: teacher adding the political response, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 担当の国務大臣はどう答えたんですか？
lines.en: How did the responsible minister answer?
lines.style: student pursuing accountability, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 局長を通じて、対策を進めると説明しました。
lines.en: Through the bureau director, they said measures would proceed.
lines.style: teacher relaying the official line, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 専門の相談窓口も設立されるとか。
lines.en: A specialized help desk will be set up too.
lines.style: teen noting a concrete outcome, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 副大臣がその責任者になるそうです。
lines.en: A deputy minister will reportedly head it.
lines.style: student adding a final detail, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence
